newsitem.title: FINLAND: Telecom Finland 1996 mobile subscribers up 36 pct.
newsitem.headline: Telecom Finland 1996 mobile subscribers up 36 pct.

text.p: State-owned Telecom Finland's mobile phone subscriptions rose last year by 321,100 or 36 percent to 1.21 million, a company spokesman said on Monday.
Digital GSM (Global System for Mobile Communication) subscriptions rose the sharpest -- by 329,400 units or 130 percent to 582,600, the spokesman told Reuters by telephone.
While digital subscriptions more than doubled, analog NMT 900 (Nordic Mobile Telecommunications) subscriptions were unchanged at 440,000, he said.
Subscriptions in the older NMT 450 network fell to 188,500 from 197,800.
Last week, the association of Finnish electronics wholesalers said 1996 sales of new mobile phones in Finland totalled 500,000 units and that it expected sales to rise to 600,000 this year.
